info.name: Student Management System – Subject Management
info.description: Subject CRUD and Student–Subject assignment requests. Run the requests in order using the Student Management Local environment. The environment must contain an existing studentId for assignment requests.

request.description: Creates a subject and saves its generated ID into subjectId.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Subject response contains an ID', function () { pm.expect(data.id).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Subject fields are correct', function () { pm.expect(data.subjectCode).to.eql('CS101'); pm.expect(data.subjectName).to.eql('Programming Fundamentals'); });

request.description: Returns all subjects. An empty database produces an empty JSON array.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Returns the subject created by Register Subject.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Returned subject uses the saved ID', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('subjectId'))); });

request.description: Updates the subject without changing its generated ID.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Assigns the selected subject to the existing studentId. The student must already exist.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

pm.test('Assignment references the selected IDs', function () { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.studentId).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('studentId'))); pm.expect(data.subjectId).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('subjectId'))); });

request.description: Lists all subjects assigned to the selected student.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Lists all students assigned to the selected subject.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Removes only the assignment. It does not delete the student or subject. Run this before Delete Subject.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 204 No Content', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });

request.description: Deletes the subject after its assignment has been removed. Deleting an assigned subject returns 409 Conflict.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 204 No Content', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
